text:
alex morrison: Quick question — we need to tighten who can kick off prod pushes for the sprint. Is there a single minimum role we should require for deploy-bot triggers?

maria chen: short answer: not officially documented. ops has been using `deploy-operator` + JIT MFA but enforcement is spotty.

jamal khan: we had informal rule: only people on the release rota or oncall can press, and they should have MFA + 2fa on their service token. but yeah, not codified.

alex morrison: ok — need to decide today. two options: 1) require `deploy-operator` + user MFA for all manual triggers; 2) allow `release-engineer` role without MFA if paired with canary + automatic rollback. preferences?

priya rao: option 1 is safer. option 2 sounds convenient but we've seen delayed rollbacks cause blast radius.

maria chen: +1 for option 1. we can allow short-lived exemption for emergency hotfixes via oncall approval channel, logged in audit.

jamal khan: agree. also propose smaller change: add a policy check in the deploy-bot that rejects manual prod triggers from non-mfa users with a clear error. (deploy-bot should link docs).

deploy-bot: policy-check: rejecting request — user_missing_mfa. See https://internal.redwood/infra/deploy-perms for remediation.

alex morrison: example command we'd want blocked: ```bash
# someone without mfa tries to press
deploy-bot trigger --env=prod --version=v2026.03.1 --canary=10
```

priya rao: will add a short PR to the deploy-bot repo to enforce MFA header and return helpful error codes. I can draft the message for the release rota so people know the new requirement.

maria chen: also add a fallback path: if oncall needs to push urgently, they open a policy-approval request in #release-approvals and an engineer with `deploy-admin` can proxy-press (and we log who proxied).

jamal khan: and let's pin the allowed roles in the console UI so the devex team can show a warning banner when you try to press without proper role. UX: red banner + link to MFA setup.

alex morrison: sounds good. action items: priya create PR for deploy-bot MFA reject (due EOD), maria update release rota post explaining proxy flow, jamal add console banner ticket. I'll schedule a 15m sync after PR merge to update the runbook.

sre-oncall: noting: if we enforce MFA, we should whitelist the deployer service account used by CI (it runs with signed keys). verify CI tokens are rotated.

priya rao: will verify CI token rotation as part of the PR.

alex morrison: thanks all. tagging folks for visibility: @maria chen @jamal khan @priya rao :thumbsup:

maria chen: :+1:

jamal khan: :shipit:

deploy-bot: queued job: policy-lint (PR #1423) will run on merge.
